family.description: The structure of this family has been solved. It comprises a 12-stranded beta barrel with a central C-terminal alpha helix. This helix is thought to be a transmembrane helix. It is structurally similar to the C-terminal domain of the Tubby protein [[cite:PUB00057493]]. In plants it plays a role in defense against pathogens [[cite:PUB00057494]].
family.name: LURP-one-related
